category.quote: A pension of Rs.300/- per month is provided to Widows between 40 years and 79 years.

gender.quote: The applicant must be a widow in the age group of 40-79 years.

age.quote: The applicant must be a widow in the age group of 40-79 years.

gate_notes: Applicant must be a widow; pension discontinued in case of remarriage of widow
Applicant must belong to household living below poverty line; pension discontinued once widow moves above poverty line
